smoke.command: paseo_tmp=$(CDPATH= cd -- "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" && pwd -P) && env -i PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR="$paseo_tmp" sh tests/run-tests.sh smoke

select.command: paseo_tmp=$(CDPATH= cd -- "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" && pwd -P) && env -i PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR="$paseo_tmp" bash -o pipefail -c 'git diff --name-only --no-renames -z origin/main... | sh tests/run-tests.sh select-paths | sh tests/run-tests.sh select'
